title: BTC vs ETH relative momentum and ratio mean reversion, fully collateralized

mechanism.description: Relative momentum: each day go 100% (of NAV) into the spot of whichever of BTC/ETH had the higher trailing 30-day close-to-close return, otherwise hold cash. Long-winner/cash form only; no perp leg, no leverage.
alternatives_tested: relative momentum 30d and 90d, dollar-neutral long-winner spot / short-loser perp (0.5/0.5, gross 1.0, net 0)
log(BTC/ETH) ratio mean reversion, lookbacks 20d and 60d, banded |z|>=2 entry / |z|<=1 exit
log(BTC/ETH) ratio mean reversion, lookbacks 20d and 60d, z-scaled fading beyond |z|>1
mechanism.rejected_mechanisms: All five dollar-neutral variants had negative development Sharpe (-0.11 to -0.58); ratio mean reversion is negative at both lookbacks and both modes, so the dn/mr branch was falsified at the development stage before the frozen comparison.

data_used.availability_note: 2024-01-01 and 2024-01-02 have partial (US-variant epoch) spot files; all WAL/cash figures unaffected. 366 validation days observed.

parameters.rebalance: daily at first hourly print (next-bar execution vs prior close signal)
parameters.weights: 1.0 winner spot / 0 cash when a winner exists; 0/0 during first 30 days
parameters.collateral: no leverage: fully cash-collateralized; no short legs in the frozen trial

signal_timing.signal_inputs: hourly spot closes with close_time <= 00:00 UTC of day D (_last usable input is the D-1 daily close)
signal_timing.fill: first trade print of day D (open of the 00:00 hourly bar); next-bar relative to the signal
signal_timing.return_convention: day D return = NAV(end of D, marked at D+1 open or D close on the final day) / NAV(post-fill D) - 1; costs charged inside the chain at fill
signal_timing.leakage_proof: signal-day alignment with the same-day open-close outcome is 0.504 (chance level); a shifted-signal run reproduces the pipeline in metrics.json
signal_timing.funding_convention: funding event at time T is charged to the position that held the settled interval; events at 00:00:xx settle the prior interval and belong to the previous day's position

cost_model.application: cost = notional traded x bps at fill on each leg, charged to cash at the same instant as the trade (inside the NAV chain)
cost_model.funding: actual Binance funding events on perp short legs, charged at perp close marks; the frozen trial has no perp leg so funding only affects benchmarks and tested dn variants

benchmark.description: equal-weight BTC/ETH spot buy-and-hold, 12 bps entry cost per leg once, weights drift (no rebalancing)
secondary_benchmarks: static_dn: long 0.5 BTC spot + short 0.5 ETH perp entered once, funding on the short ETH leg, no rebalancing
cash (0% risk-free): development window has no positive-rate day that the strategies' cash legs can claim

first_falsification_gate.predeclared_rule: a trial advances to the frozen validation comparison only if development net Sharpe > 0, development 2x-cost cumulative excess >= 0 vs equal-weight BTC/ETH, and average daily turnover <= 33% of NAV
first_falsification_gate.applied_to: all 8 predeclared trials on the development window only (2020-08-01..2023-12-31)
failed_by: T5/T6/T7/T8 (negative dev Sharpe; ratio mean reversion at 20d/60d banded/zfade all falsified in development)

reasons: validation net Sharpe 1.096 is positive but BELOW the named benchmark ew_spot_bah Sharpe 1.3712
validation cumulative excess vs benchmark is -0.1652 at 1x costs and -0.1653 at 2x costs (negative in both cost regimes)
residual performance is 0.83 beta on the equal-weight benchmark with annualized alpha -7.5%; no relative-value alpha survives
gate_result.verdict: falsified: relative momentum picks BTC/ETH rotations whose validation underperformance is timing noise around long-crypto exposure, and the mechanism's excess was only +5.2% cumulative over a 3.4-year development window (0.156 daily-excess Sharpe) - within noise of zero

leakage_checks.signal_lag: signals computed only from closes through day i-1; fills at day i open (verified in _signal); day-0 and lookback warm-up days are flat
leakage_checks.no_holdout_reads: run.py fails closed on --end > 2024-12-31 without QUANT_HOLDOUT_UNLOCK=1; never set in wave one; all metrics above come from 2020-08-01..2024-12-31
leakage_checks.embargo_note: no observation after 2024-12-31 was loaded, computed, or reported; the 2025-2026 files exist in the manifest but were never opened
leakage_checks.partial_day_note: 2024-01-01/02 spot files use a US-epoch variant; metrics.json documents their inclusion and they hold no signal role beyond being trading days

risks: The frozen trial's development-edge (+5.2% cumulative excess over 3.4y) is statistically indistinguishable from zero, so validation underperformance may be noise rather than a structural break; either way the mechanism is not deployable above buy-and-hold.
Equal-weight buy-and-hold dominates every variant in validation; cost floors (12 bps spot one-way) mean any daily-rebalanced long-only rotation needs materially larger gross excess to clear 2x costs.

Funding modeling is exact at event granularity but marks use the hourly perp close nearest the settlement stamp; a sub-hourly mark could shift annualized funding P&L by a few bps (does not affect the frozen trial, which is spot-only).
The 30/90-day and 20/60-day lookbacks are the only families tested; other horizons are untested and outside the 8-trial budget.

Per protocol-amendment.json, 2025-2026 is historical_confirmation (parameter-embargoed, not epistemically blind) and this family may send at most one candidate; given the validation failure, no candidate should advance.
next_experiment: Do not advance a holdout candidate for this family. If work continues post-wave-one, test whether plain static long-crypto with vol-scaled rebalancing (no relative signal) is not dominated, i.e. whether relative rotation adds any value at free frequency; and test the dollar-neutral pair with shorter (5-10d) lookbacks where the 0.5/0.5 beta structure may capture genuine lead-lag. All away from the 8-trial budget already spent.
